name: Cleric Ascendant Autocrat
body:
An ascendant autocrat is a priest of a dire faith that represents oppression and control.

Requirements
Alignment: An ascendant autocrat must be lawful evil and within one step of their deity’s.
Ascendant Autocrat’s Code: An ascendant autocrat must abide by the same restrictions as listed in the tyrant code of the antipaladin’s tyrant archetype.
Deity: An ascendant autocrat must worship either a lawful evil or lawful neutral deity that grants clerics access to two of the following subdomains listed below (the ascendant autocrat’s domain must be selected from this list).
Subdomains: devil, domination*, hatred, slavery, sovereignty, and tyranny.
Features
Skills

An ascendant autocrat gains Bluff as a class skill. This ability alters class skills.

Aura of Law (Ex)

Beginning with 1st level, an ascendant autocrat exudes an aura of law (see detect law) equal to their ascendant autocrat class level. A character who uses smite law on an ascendant autocrat deals 2 points of damage per class level on their first attack against them. This ability alters aura.

Diminished Channeling

Beginning with 1st level, an ascendant autocrat trades some of their spiritual strength for dominating power. This ability functions as channel energy, except the number of daily uses is equal to the ascendant autocrat’s Charisma modifier.

Additionally, an ascendant autocrat must choose to channel negative energy when they first gain this ability.

This ability alters channel energy. However, an ascendant autocrat can select another cleric archetype that alters or replaces channel energy, but the daily uses of the replacing ability, if any, cannot normally be more than the ascendant autocrat’s Charisma modifier and any use of channel energy, if applicable, must always be negative energy.

Diminished Spellcasting

Beginning with 1st level, an ascendant autocrat forgoes some of the traditional training in the divine magic that most of the clergy receive. An ascendant autocrat chooses only one domain from their deity’s list of domains, and they receive one less spell slot at each spell level. If an ascendant autocrat gains no spells per day at a spell level, they can cast domain spells of that level normally, but can only cast non-domain spells of that level if they gain them as bonus spells. This ability alters spellcasting and domains.

Autocrat’s Gaze (Ex)

Starting at 2nd level, an ascendant autocrat gains a +1 circumstance bonus on all Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive skill checks. At 6th level and every 4 class levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +1 (max of +5 at 19th level).

Telekinetic Weapon (Sp)

At 11th level, a weapon binder can control their bound weapon, and only their bonded weapon, as per the sustained force option of telekinesis. While the bonded weapon is flying in this way, the weapon binder can monitor the area around the weapon with clairaudience/clairvoyance as a swift action.

This ability can be used once per day at 11th level, and an additional time per day at 15th level and again at 19th level.

This ability can be used for 2 rounds per weapon binder level for each use.

This ability replaces the arcane strategies gained at 11th and 15th levels.

Aura of the Despot (Su)

Starting at 3rd level, an ascendant autocrat’s dominating presence exerts a tangible suppressing aura that affects other creatures within 20 feet of them. This aura imposes a -2 penalty on affected creatures to their saving throws against fear effects created by an ascendant autocrat. Affected creatures that are normally immune to fear do not gain that immunity against an ascendant autocrat’s fear effects unless their HD is 4 higher than their own character level.

At 7th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the range of aura of the despot increases by 10 feet and its imposed penalty increases by -1, to a maximum of 60 feet and -6 penalty at 19th level.

Additionally, an ascendant autocrat is immune to fear effects except for those created from a source of an HD or CL 4 higher than their own character level.

Nefarious Leadership (Ex)

Starting at 5th level, through blackmail, coercion, and displays of superiority and leadership, an ascendant autocrat has begun to amass loyal and fanatical followers under the banner of their deity. An ascendant autocrat gains Vile Leadership as a bonus feat for which they do not have to meet the prerequisites. However, the ascendant autocrat initially cannot have a cohort and their followers can only be recruited from classes that grants proficiency with all martial weapons as a class feature.

At 7th level, an ascendant autocrat can recruit normal followers as per the Vile Leadership feat and they gain a monstrous cohort instead of a normal cohort.

They also gain a +2 bonus to their Leadership score that increases by +2 at 11th and 15th levels.

An ascendant despot loses the channel energy increases gained at 5th, 9th, and 13th levels.

Autocrat’s Regalia

Starting at 7th level, an ascendant autocrat has been taught how to best utilize the traditional symbols of power that exemplifies ruling through fear and might with greater efficiency. When an ascendant autocrat activates or uses a special ability or spell from a magic item from gauntlet(s) of any kind, morningstars, rods, or scepters, the CL and save DC (if any) of such effects increases by +1. At 12th and 17th levels, the bonus increases by +1. This increase applies even to such effects that are triggered by meeting specific conditions, such as confirming a critical hit on a target.

Channel Energy

An ascendant despot loses the channel energy increases gained at 7th, 11th, and 15th levels. This ability affects channel energy.
